name: File
description: A file in the Files drive: its source of truth (a stored attachment, or another document such as an invoice or a contact), the content extracted from or rendered for it in any MIME type (plain text, html, pdf, preview images), and a title, a description and coloured tags on top.

global.schema:
type FileState {
  title: String
  description: String
  "The source of truth: a stored file, or another document. Null until set."
  source: FileSource
  "Content extracted from or rendered for the source: text, html, pdf, images"
  renditions: [FileRendition!]!
  tags: [FileTag!]!
  "A change a folder sync found on disk that is not pulled yet. Null when there is none."
  placeholder: FilePlaceholder
}

enum FileSourceKind {
  ATTACHMENT
  DOCUMENT
  "A file found on disk whose bytes are not pulled yet"
  FILE_PLACEHOLDER
  "A document (.phd) found on disk that is not imported yet"
  DOCUMENT_PLACEHOLDER
}

type FileSource {
  kind: FileSourceKind!
  "ATTACHMENT: the stored bytes and what they are"
  ref: AttachmentRef
  fileName: String
  mimeType: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  "DOCUMENT: the document this file stands for, its type and a cached name"
  documentId: PHID
  documentType: String
  documentName: String
  setAt: DateTime!
}

type FileRendition {
  id: OID!
  "Any MIME type: text/plain, text/html, application/pdf, image/png"
  mimeType: String!
  "A free-form role, e.g. preview, ocr, pdf-export, thumbnail"
  type: String
  label: String
  "Stored content"
  ref: AttachmentRef
  fileName: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  "Or inline text content"
  text: String
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

type FileTag {
  id: OID!
  label: String!
  "A colour name from the design system: forest, sage, mint, clay, amber, info, neutral"
  color: String!
}

enum FilePlaceholderChange {
  CREATE
  UPDATE
  DELETE
}

enum FilePlaceholderTarget {
  FILE
  DOCUMENT
}

"A change found on disk by a folder sync, waiting to be pulled"
type FilePlaceholder {
  change: FilePlaceholderChange!
  target: FilePlaceholderTarget!
  "The folder sync that found it"
  mappingId: PHID!
  "Where it is below the mapping's local folder"
  relativePath: String!
  fileName: String!
  mimeType: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  "SHA-256 hex of the content on disk; null when it was deleted"
  hash: String
  modifiedAt: DateTime
  "DOCUMENT: what the .phd holds"
  documentId: PHID
  documentType: String
  documentName: String
  foundAt: DateTime!
}

modules.name: content
modules.description: Title, description and the source of truth

operations.name: SET_TITLE
operations.description: Rename the file; empty clears it
operations.reducer:
const t = action.input.title?.trim();
state.title = t ? t : null;

operations.name: SET_DESCRIPTION
operations.description: Describe the file; empty clears it
operations.reducer:
const d = action.input.description?.trim();
state.description = d ? d : null;

operations.name: SET_ATTACHMENT_SOURCE
operations.description: Make a stored file the source of truth, replacing any source
operations.schema:
input SetAttachmentSourceInput {
  ref: AttachmentRef!
  fileName: String!
  mimeType: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  setAt: DateTime!
}

errors.name: InvalidSourceFileNameError
errors.description: The source file name is empty

operations.name: SET_DOCUMENT_SOURCE
operations.description: Make another document the source of truth, replacing any source

errors.name: InvalidSourceDocumentTypeError
errors.description: The source document type is empty

operations.name: CLEAR_SOURCE
operations.description: Remove the source; renditions and tags stay

operations.name: ADD_RENDITION
operations.description: Add extracted or rendered content: stored (ref) or inline (text), exactly one
operations.schema:
input AddRenditionInput {
  id: OID!
  mimeType: String!
  type: String
  label: String
  ref: AttachmentRef
  fileName: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  text: String
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

errors.name: DuplicateRenditionError
errors.description: A rendition with that id exists already

errors.name: InvalidRenditionMimeTypeError
errors.description: The MIME type is not of the form type/subtype

errors.name: RenditionContentError
errors.description: A rendition needs exactly one of ref or text

operations.name: UPDATE_RENDITION
operations.description: Change a rendition's type, label or MIME type; an omitted field is kept, an empty one cleared

errors.name: InvalidUpdatedMimeTypeError
errors.description: The new MIME type is not of the form type/subtype

operations.name: REMOVE_RENDITION
ADD_TAG
operations.description: Tag the file; a label is unique on the file, ignoring case

errors.name: DuplicateTagError
errors.description: The file carries that tag id or label already

operations.name: UPDATE_TAG
operations.description: Rename or recolour a tag; an omitted field is kept

errors.name: EmptyTagLabelError
errors.description: The new tag label is empty

errors.name: TagLabelTakenError
errors.description: Another tag on the file has that label

operations.name: REMOVE_TAG

modules.name: disk
modules.description: Changes a folder sync found on disk: recorded as a placeholder, then pulled

operations.name: SET_PLACEHOLDER
operations.schema:
input SetPlaceholderInput {
  change: FilePlaceholderChange!
  target: FilePlaceholderTarget!
  mappingId: PHID!
  relativePath: String!
  fileName: String!
  mimeType: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  hash: String
  modifiedAt: DateTime
  documentId: PHID
  documentType: String
  documentName: String
  foundAt: DateTime!
}

errors.name: InvalidPlaceholderError
errors.description: A placeholder needs the path and the file name

errors.name: PlaceholderTargetError
errors.description: CREATE is for a File without a source; UPDATE and DELETE are for a File with one

operations.name: APPLY_DISK_VERSION
operations.schema:
input ApplyDiskVersionInput {
  ref: AttachmentRef!
  fileName: String!
  mimeType: String
  sizeBytes: Int
  setAt: DateTime!
  "The id the replaced source gets in the renditions, as the previous version"
  previousId: OID!
}

errors.name: NoDiskVersionError
errors.description: There is no file created or updated on disk to pull

errors.name: PreviousVersionIdTakenError
errors.description: The previous version's rendition id is taken
